purpose: One independent source-feasibility experiment for joint A/B task-function compensation with separate active input searches and finite projection uncertainty. Not a repair of069e or an asserted new effective defense.
construction_access: Pinned original MNIST expert, public base, original fixed target head/classIDs, fixed task32SVD, original clean authorAGA. No other candidate, old generated input/counterexample, real image, partner, or test result is read.

source.warmup_loss: maximum requested-class CE over all views and three clean states: original/native and clean public direct/AGA means
source.no_filter: All final inputs remain, including confidence failures.

native_critic: Minimize clean requested-class CE minus KL(teacher||protected_native) at temperature4; input gradients through both frozen networks. This seeks native discrepancies without real images.
merge_critic: Minimize clean requested-class CE plus the minimum protected wrong-class robust margin over the two public means, divided by rho. This seeks a useful clean merge that the current protection still fails to disrupt.
robust_margin: H(z,y)=max(j!=y) z*P*(w_j-w_y)/(norm(z)*norm(P,F)*norm(w_j-w_y))-rho. z is the actual post-LN row. H>0 is sufficient for one wrong competitor to beat y for every P perturbation in the declared Frobenius ball at fixed z. It is not a prefix/unknown-partner guarantee.

actor.parameters: Only original lastMLP A/B numerical increments; biases and every other tensor frozen. Start deltaA=deltaB=0, no old point initialization.
actor.task_constraint: Project deltaA off both task32left/right singular probes and original LN2bias input response; project deltaB off task32right probes.
actor.loss: 10*maximum native KL over both buffers/views + maximum softplus(-H/rho) over both public states and both buffers/views -0.01*(relativeA^2+relativeB^2). Teacher target detached only during actor update.
actor.gradient_metric: Euclidean in deltaA/norm(A),deltaB/norm(B); normalize joint gradient, project and clip individual caps after every step.
actor.author_matching: Use unchanged author lastMLP Hungarian at each outer cycle and final source evaluation; fixed assignment during each five-step actor block. Count separately from fullAGA attacks.
actor.no_sweep: No continuation, best-iteration selection, alternative class/rank/seed/layer/radius/step or optimizer retry.

source_acceptance.clean_requested_classes: At least190/200views simultaneously agree with requested classes in all three clean states.
source_acceptance.public_protection: Each public state has at most40/200teacher-class predictions and at least180/200positive robust wrong-class margins.
source_acceptance.FP32_full_source: Freeze sole point first, then compare full-model and captured-tail scores in original source microbatch contexts. Any nonfinite or implementation mismatch stops and preserves evidence.

later_evaluation: Only source support permits a separately frozen independent active-input check and complete native MNIST accuracy, followed by fixed realTA0.5/originalAGA target-only/both. No source score is natural accuracy. Historical D0.5/R0.5 retained separately; primary full native loss criterion0.5pp.
hypothesis: Optimizing actual task outputs against separate native and merge input critics, with finite projection-margin support, may realize a useful joint compensation that fixed hidden reflection and teacher-only prototypes did not. This single trial can fail at source; no general success or novelty inferred.
novelty_boundary: ABM/DFAD adversarial input generation, KL, SVD, projected gradient and linear norm support are known. The claimed research question is their concrete task-function/anti-merging compatibility under frozen original expert and zero real construction images; no new-method claim before actual evidence.
